decision.observed_event: Turn order: the fourth player, the dealer, the door-side player, the fresco-side player, you. The fourth player hits you twice: 14 bludgeoning damage. The dealer hits you once: 5 piercing damage. The door-side player hits you: 4 slashing damage. The fresco-side player hits you: 4 slashing damage. Your greataxe hits the dealer. The dealer is hurt. The fourth player hits you once: 7 bludgeoning damage. The dealer breaks off, snatches up what he can reach, and runs out through the south door, shouting blame at the others over his shoulder. The door-side player bolts through the south door after the dealer. The fresco-side player shoves past the table and runs out through the south door. Your turn.

improv_read.connection: Uktarl avoids personal risk; once blood is drawn he pushes the others in front of him.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit narrates only what the table resolved and hands the fight back.

public_brief.visible_cue: The fourth player stays, unhurt, while the others run.
public_brief.player_opening: It is her turn to act.
public_brief.reply_to: Rolling initiative if it comes to that. I rage and swing my greataxe.
public_brief.kit_focus: Play the round in order, then leave the fourth player alone facing her.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, tight, no humor: fast and physical

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The fourth player is fastest. Its sap cracks her ribs twice. The dealer's knife finds her side, and two short blades bite her arms. Then Brakka rages and hews into the dealer. The sap lands once more. The other three break and run, the ring going with the dealer.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: This is your doing, all of you! I said leave the gold! I said she wanted it! Run, you idiots, run, and the next time I tell you a thing, listen to me!

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: Thirty-four damage. Only the fourth player stayed. Your turn.
